results.sql: SELECT d.id, d.name, d.accession_id, d.bids_version, d.dataset_type, d.source_type, d.remote_url, d.validation_status, d.authors, d.institutions, d.description_text, COUNT(DISTINCT o.subject) AS subject_count FROM bids_datasets AS d LEFT JOIN bids_objects AS o ON o.dataset_id = d.id AND NOT o.subject IS NULL WHERE (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bids_objects AS o2 WHERE o2.dataset_id = d.id AND o2.task IN ('geospatial_navigation', 'spatial_navigation_task')) OR d.search_tsv @@ to_tsquery('english', 'spatial:AB & navigation:AB')) AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bids_participants AS p2 WHERE p2.dataset_id = d.id AND p2.diagnosis = 'healthy_control') OR d.search_tsv @@ to_tsquery('english', 'healthy:AB')) AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bids_participants AS p3 WHERE p3.dataset_id = d.id AND p3.age >= 18 AND p3.age <= 35) OR (d.age_min <= 35 AND d.age_max >= 18)) AND d.search_tsv @@ to_tsquery('english', 'healthy') GROUP BY d.id

results.question: Tourette syndrome or other tic disorder datasets, or dystonia
results.rank_tsquery: (tourette | syndrome) | (tic | disorder) | (dystonia | (dystonic & movements) | blepharospasm | (writer & cramp) | (dystonic & disorder) | (dystonic & syndrome) | hemidystonia | (dystonic & posturing) | (spasmodic & torticollis))
results.explanation: Find datasets containing participants with Tourette syndrome, other tic disorders, or dystonia.
results.sql: SELECT d.id, d.name, d.accession_id, d.bids_version, d.dataset_type, d.source_type, d.remote_url, d.validation_status, d.authors, d.institutions, d.description_text, COUNT(DISTINCT o.subject) AS subject_count FROM bids_datasets AS d LEFT JOIN bids_objects AS o ON o.dataset_id = d.id AND NOT o.subject IS NULL WHERE ((d.search_tsv @@ to_tsquery('english', 'tourette & syndrome') AND d.search_tsv @@ to_tsquery('english', 'tic')) OR (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bids_participants AS p2 WHERE p2.dataset_id = d.id AND p2.diagnosis IN ('dystonia')) OR d.search_tsv @@ to_tsquery('english', 'dystonia:AB | (dystonic:AB & movements:AB) | blepharospasm:AB | (writer:AB & cramp:AB) | (dystonic:AB & disorder:AB) | (dystonic:AB & syndrome:AB) | hemidystonia:AB | (dystonic:AB & posturing:AB) | (spasmodic:AB & torticollis:AB)'))) GROUP BY d.id

results.question: Datasets of cannabis users or cocaine users
results.explanation: Find datasets containing participants who are cannabis users or cocaine users.
results.sql: SELECT d.id, d.name, d.accession_id, d.bids_version, d.dataset_type, d.source_type, d.remote_url, d.validation_status, d.authors, d.institutions, d.description_text, COUNT(DISTINCT o.subject) AS subject_count FROM bids_datasets AS d LEFT JOIN bids_objects AS o ON o.dataset_id = d.id AND NOT o.subject IS NULL WHERE d.search_tsv @@ to_tsquery('english', 'cannabis') OR d.search_tsv @@ to_tsquery('english', 'cocaine') GROUP BY d.id

results.question: Autism datasets that do not include children (adults only)
results.rank_tsquery: autism | autistic | (asperger & syndrome) | aspergers | (pervasive & developmental & disorders)
results.explanation: Find datasets with participants diagnosed with Autism, including only adults and excluding children.
results.sql: SELECT d.id, d.name, d.accession_id, d.bids_version, d.dataset_type, d.source_type, d.remote_url, d.validation_status, d.authors, d.institutions, d.description_text, COUNT(DISTINCT o.subject) AS subject_count FROM bids_datasets AS d LEFT JOIN bids_objects AS o ON o.dataset_id = d.id AND NOT o.subject IS NULL WHERE (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bids_participants AS p2 WHERE p2.dataset_id = d.id AND p2.diagnosis IN ('autism_spectrum_disorder')) OR d.search_tsv @@ to_tsquery('english', 'autism:AB | autistic:AB | (asperger:AB & syndrome:AB) | aspergers:AB | (pervasive:AB & developmental:AB & disorders:AB)')) AND NOT (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bids_participants AS p2 WHERE p2.dataset_id = d.id AND p2.age < 18) OR d.age_min < 18) AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bids_participants AS p2 WHERE p2.dataset_id = d.id AND p2.age >= 18) OR d.age_max >= 18) GROUP BY d.id
